# Summary
Supporting 1 of 4 in the August 2026 low water pressure cluster. Target publish Thu 14 Aug 2026; page tracker shows it published 2026-08-12 at `/blog/low-water-pressure-shower-only/`.

# Key facts
- Primary keyword: low water pressure in shower only. Intent: Informational (TOFU). Target 900 to 1,200 words. No byline (client direction), Organization publisher schema only.
- Core answer: If only the shower is weak the problem is at the fixture: scaled showerhead, worn or scaled mixing cartridge, flow restrictor, or a partly closed stop valve. The showerhead fix is a vinegar soak.
- External source table: City of Mesa Water Quality (verified earlier, re-check); flow restrictor rule unverified, so the draft says to leave the restrictor alone. Hidden-leak anchor de-duped per linking rules.
- Status line: AI first draft, editorially improved and simplified; fill `[CLIENT INPUT]` blocks and verify external sources before publish. Up-link to the pillar goes live only once the pillar is live.
